name: graded-reader-skills
description: Skills for building vocabulary-graded readers: scoring a corpus by a reader's comprehension, tokenizing across scripts, aligning audio to a known text, and publishing derived metrics from a corpus you don't own.

plugins.name: graded-reader
plugins.description: Four skills extracted from a working vocabulary-graded Bible reader (English, Biblical Hebrew, Koine Greek + 9 more languages): comprehension scoring and learning order, multilingual tokenization, cloud-ASR forced alignment, and derived-dataset publishing.
